relations.note: God transforms the hospitable old man’s daughter into the immortal yerba-mate plant.
In the workers’ version, God makes her immortal owner of yerba mate.
Saint Peter endorses generously rewarding her father, after which God makes her immortal.
Saint John endorses generously rewarding her father, after which God makes her immortal.

relations.myth: Tupã, Yarí and her aged father
relations.note: Tupã creates yerba mate and appoints Yarí its eternal divine protectress.

relations.myth: Jasy and Araí: the Moon’s gift
relations.note: In some versions, Jasy creates yerba mate and appoints the hunter’s daughter Caá-Yarí.
relations.source: Neli Garrido de Rodríguez, Leyendas Argentinas

relations.myth: Jasy and Araí: the Moon’s gift
relations.note: Araí accompanies Jasy and participates in the reward that sometimes appoints Caá-Yarí.
relations.source: Neli Garrido de Rodríguez, Leyendas Argentinas
